chapters.title: JavaScript Jam Introductions and React Miami Collaboration
chapters.description: After resolving Twitter Spaces connection issues, Ishan Anand, Anthony Campolo, and Scott Steinlage introduce JavaScript Jam Live and its React Miami collaboration. They preview upcoming speaker appearances and special activities while emphasizing the show’s open-mic format, welcoming questions and contributions from web developers of every experience level.

chapters.title: Miami Jam: Bringing Trivia and Audience Participation to Speaker Interviews
chapters.description: Dev Agrawal and organizer Michelle introduce their involvement with React Miami before Dev outlines Miami Jam, a game-show-style alternative to traditional interviews. React, JavaScript, and TypeScript trivia will spark speaker discussions, shared experiences, and audience participation, including scoring answers.
